<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 390 844">
  <defs>
    <filter id="shadow" x="-20%" y="-20%" width="140%" height="140%">
      <feDropShadow dx="0" dy="2" stdDeviation="3" flood-color="#063336" flood-opacity=".10"/>
    </filter>
  </defs>

  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" fill="#FFFFFF"/>

  <!-- Status bar -->

    <text x="22" y="20" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="500" fill="#121212">9:41</text>
    <line x1="329" y1="14" x2="333" y2="14" stroke="#121212" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="336" y1="11" x2="340" y2="11" stroke="#121212" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="343" y1="8" x2="347" y2="8" stroke="#121212" stroke-width="2"/>
    <circle cx="312" cy="13" r="2.5" fill="#121212"/>
    <line x1="305" y1="17" x2="312" y2="10" stroke="#121212" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <rect x="354" y="7" width="21" height="12" rx="3" fill="none" stroke="#121212" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <rect x="357" y="10" width="14" height="6" rx="1.5" fill="#5DB329"/>
    <rect x="376" y="11" width="2" height="4" rx="1" fill="#121212"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Header -->
  <g>
    <circle cx="195" cy="57" r="18" fill="#D4FCBC"/>
    <circle cx="189" cy="54" r="3" fill="#5DB329"/>
    <circle cx="201" cy="54" r="3" fill="#5DB329"/>
    <line x1="189" y1="62" x2="201" y2="62" stroke="#5DB329" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>

  <!-- Hero image panel -->
  <g filter="url(#shadow)">
    <rect x="24" y="112" width="342" height="318" rx="20" fill="#F3FAF6"/>
  </g>
  <rect x="40" y="128" width="310" height="286" rx="16" fill="#D4FCBC"/>
  <circle cx="87" cy="176" r="24" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity=".55"/>
  <circle cx="303" cy="357" r="39" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity=".38"/>
  <circle cx="292" cy="168" r="12" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity=".50"/>

  <!-- decorative food illustration -->
  <path d="M87 239 C103 221 122 217 140 227 C152 234 157 248 155 260" fill="none" stroke="#4B9460" stroke-width="5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M280 222 C273 204 281 188 297 181 C304 196 299 211 280 222" fill="#5DB329"/>
  <path d="M108 205 C119 191 133 192 143 204 C132 213 119 214 108 205" fill="#4B9460"/>

  <!-- bowl -->
  <ellipse cx="195" cy="347" rx="111" ry="27" fill="#4B9460" opacity=".25"/>
  <path d="M96 294 L294 294 C287 356 252 383 195 383 C138 383 103 356 96 294" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <ellipse cx="195" cy="295" rx="99" ry="35" fill="#4B9460"/>
  <ellipse cx="195" cy="289" rx="87" ry="27" fill="#5DB329"/>

  <circle cx="185" cy="277" r="16" fill="#E7574C"/>
  <circle cx="220" cy="286" r="14" fill="#D4FCBC"/>
  <circle cx="250" cy="278" r="11" fill="#FBBD00"/>

  <line x1="289" y1="213" x2="304" y2="202" stroke="#4B9460" stroke-width="5" stroke-linecap="round"/>

  <!-- Main copy -->
  <g>
    <text x="195" y="476" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="26" font-weight="500" fill="#0A2533">Your favorite meals,</text>
    <text x="195" y="510" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="26" font-weight="500" fill="#5DB329">delivered with love.</text>
    <text x="195" y="545" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#666666">Discover homemade flavors from kitchens</text>
    <text x="195" y="566" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#666666">near you, made fresh and ready to enjoy.</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Progress indicator -->
  <g>
    <rect x="151" y="594" width="34" height="6" rx="3" fill="#5DB329"/>
    <rect x="192" y="594" width="9" height="6" rx="3" fill="#D9D9D9"/>
    <rect x="208" y="594" width="9" height="6" rx="3" fill="#D9D9D9"/>

  <g filter="url(#shadow)">

  <g>
    <text x="195" y="724" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="500" fill="#4B9460">Skip for now</text>

  </g>

  <!-- Bottom navigation -->
  <rect x="0" y="770" width="390" height="74" fill="#FFFFFF"/>

  <g>

    <polygon points="48,793 58,785 68,793" fill="none" stroke="#5DB329" stroke-width="2"/>
    <rect x="52" y="792" width="12" height="11" rx="2" fill="none" stroke="#5DB329" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="58" y="821" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="500" fill="#5DB329">Home</text>

    <circle cx="137" cy="793" r="8" fill="none" stroke="#999999" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="143" y1="799" x2="149" y2="805" stroke="#999999" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <text x="137" y="821" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="400" fill="#666666">Explore</text>

    <rect x="210" y="786" width="17" height="17" rx="3" fill="none" stroke="#999999" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="214" y1="790" x2="223" y2="790" stroke="#999999" stroke-width="1.5"/>

    <text x="219" y="821" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="400" fill="#666666">Orders</text>

    <!-- Profile -->
    <circle cx="315" cy="791" r="6" fill="none" stroke="#999999" stroke-width="2"/>
    <ellipse cx="315" cy="801" rx="10" ry="5" fill="none" stroke="#999999" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="315" y="821" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="400" fill="#666666">Profile</text>
  </g>
</svg>
